newsitem.title: USA: Rubin, Mitsuzuka didn't discuss forex -- US official.
newsitem.headline: Rubin, Mitsuzuka didn't discuss forex -- US official.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka did not discuss foreign exchange rates in a telephone call on Tuesday, a U.S. Treasury Department spokeswoman said.
The two men though did discuss financial services, including Japan's insurance market, she said.
The United States and Japan are at odds over deregulation of Japan's insurance market but have vowed to try to settle their differences by December 15.
In a statement released by Treasury after the telephone conversation, Rubin welcomed Japan's new financial reform proposals and said he looked forward to learning more about them.
Rubin, who was out of the office in the latter half of last week on vacation, also offered Mitsuzuka close cooperation on issues of mutual interest, the statement said.
